morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆；末尾 c 读 /t͡ʃ/。无常用词缀派生形式，以下列出相关复合词。

senses.zh_definition: 山毛榉；山毛榉属（Fagus）的大乔木，叶片有光泽，树皮光滑、呈灰色；木材语境中也指其木料。
senses.en_definition: A beech tree of the genus Fagus, with glossy leaves and smooth grey bark; also its timber.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pokok besar daripada genus Fagus yang mempunyai daun berkilat dan kulit kayu licin berwarna kelabu.
senses.nuances: 植物及木材名称；pokok bic 强调树木，kayu bic 强调木料。此处指 Fagus 属，并非泛指所有名称中带 beech 的树种。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=bic)；[英马对应词条](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/beech)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pembekal mengesahkan bahawa kerusi tersebut diperbuat daripada kayu bic.
dual_scenarios.zh: 供应商确认，该椅子由山毛榉木制成。
dual_scenarios.en: The supplier confirmed that the chair was made of beech wood.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Meja kayu bic ni cantiklah, tapi mahal sikit.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Meja kayu bic ini cantik, tetapi harganya agak mahal.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这张山毛榉木桌挺好看的，就是有点贵。
dual_scenarios.en: This beech table looks lovely, but it's a bit expensive.
spoken_features: ni 是 ini 的口语形式。
sikit 在此表示程度较轻，相当于 agak。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nampak meja kayu bic kat kedai tadi. Cantiklah!
messages.ms_standard: Saya melihat meja kayu bic di kedai tadi. Meja itu sangat cantik!
messages.zh: 我刚才在店里看到一张山毛榉木桌，挺好看的！
messages.en: I saw a beech table at the shop earlier. It looked lovely!

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ambil gambar je dulu, nanti kita tengok harga sama-sama.
messages.ms_standard: Ambil gambar sahaja dahulu; nanti kita semak harganya bersama-sama.
messages.zh: 先拍张照吧，回头我们一起看看价钱。
messages.en: Just take a photo first. We can check the price together later.

etymology.historical_story: Malay bic closely resembles English beech in both sound and meaning, suggesting an English borrowing, although the cited dictionary does not establish its transmission history. Its practical setting is easy to picture: a furniture buyer encounters a timber name rather than a familiar garden tree. The expressions pokok bic and kayu bic distinguish the living tree from its wood.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bic 的读音接近英语 beech；把这个短音连到“灰色光滑树皮的山毛榉”，再用 kayu bic 记住它的木材。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 中性专业名词，没有敬语或冒犯色彩；向不熟悉木材名称的人介绍时，可说明它是一种山毛榉木。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于家具采购、木材说明和植物介绍。商品沟通中宜明确说 kayu bic，避免让听者误以为在讨论树木本身。
